content.text:
I've improved the 0.html file with the following enhancements:

**Visual & UX Improvements:**
- Increased hint text opacity (0.85 → 0.9) and improved text-shadow for better readability
- Enhanced button styling with larger padding, better spacing, and more prominent hover effects
- Refined circle stroke appearance with better visibility
- Smoother scale transitions (1.06 → 1.05 for hover, more natural feel)
- Improved button active state feedback with more pronounced press effect

**Mobile Responsiveness:**
- Fixed font sizes on very small screens (added proper sizing for mode indicator and keyboard hints on 360px devices)
- Ensured keyboard shortcuts display readably on all screen sizes

**Performance & Reliability:**
- Added animation lock (`animatingColorShift` flag) to prevent rapid re-triggering of color shift animations
- This prevents janky behavior if users click/tap the cycle button repeatedly

**Accessibility:**
- Better contrast on text elements
- Improved touch target sizes for buttons (min-height: 44px maintained)
- Maintained all ARIA labels and semantic HTML

The improvements focus on polish—better visual feedback, smoother interactions, and more responsive design without changing the core functionality.
